themes.label: AI listed among climate-adaptation sectors
themes.definition: AI named as one sector in a list of areas where climate adaptation is embedded, without further discussion.
themes.inclusion: Passages where AI appears as one list item among sectors (agriculture, energy, mining) in a climate or development narrative.
themes.exclusion: Passages explaining how AI contributes to climate action or development.
themes.boundary_cases: If the passage specifies an AI application for climate (e.g. forecasting), code AI_DEVELOPMENT_SDGS instead.

examples.quote: from agriculture and energy to infrastructure and livelihoods, to sustainable mining and artificial intelligence

value.rationale: Single Kenyan passage focused on Middle East, Sudan and climate action; AI appears only as a list item among sectors where climate adaptation is embedded.
